offering_description.value: Develops and manufactures specialty performance ingredients, including encapsulated and choline-based nutrients, for food, pharmaceutical and animal nutrition makers, plus sterilization gases for medical device sterilizers. Sells mainly directly to manufacturers in batches and bulk, using chemical processing and encapsulation technology.

primary_products.value: encapsulated ingredients; choline and betaine ingredients; animal feed additives; nutritional supplement ingredients; sterilization gases

customer_segment.value: B2B: food, beverage and dietary supplement makers, pharmaceutical companies, animal feed producers, medical device sterilizers

end_markets.value: food and beverage; dietary supplements; pharmaceuticals; animal nutrition; medical devices

revenue_model.value: product sales: ingredients and sterilization gases sold to manufacturers; service fees: contract sterilization of customers' medical devices and products

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: makes specialty ingredients from chemical raw materials, sold to food, pharma and feed producers; component supplier: supplies ingredients that customers blend into their own finished products

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Asia and South America, with plants in the US and abroad

specialization.value: related lines: nutritional ingredients (human nutrition, animal nutrition) and specialty sterilization products sharing encapsulation and chemical processing know-how

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams selling to food, pharmaceutical and feed manufacturers; distributors / dealers: third-party distributors for some ingredient lines

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: FDA food ingredient and GRAS rules, plus EPA and OSHA rules for handling sterilization gases
